title.en: Gone with the Wind: five complete new editions

summary.en: Four essays on Scarlett, hunger, calculation and recognition. Five complete new editions follow the fact-checked Chinese prose; independent English retains its own form with novel-versus-film details corrected.
summary.zh: 四篇核对小说情节，区分电影细节，保留英文独立散文，补齐日法德西韩全文。
